text: EX-99.1 3 exhibit991-saleofinfrastru.htm EX-99.1 Document GIBRALTAR TO SELL INFRASTRUCTURE BUSINESS TO SAINT-GOBAIN FOR $208 MILLION Advances strategic plan to simplify and focus asset portfolio on building products and structures end-markets Proceeds to be used to reduce debt Buffalo, New York, October 15, 2026 – Gibraltar Industries, Inc. (Nasdaq: ROCK), a leading manufacturer and provider of products and services for the residential and agtech markets, today announced that it has entered into an agreement to sell its Infrastructure business, D.S. Brown, to Saint-Gobain for $208 million in cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. The sale is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026 subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals. "This sale is another step in the simplification of our portfolio, sharpening our strategic focus and resource allocation on the building products and structures end-markets to drive greater value and returns for our stockholders," stated Chairman and CEO Bill Bosway. “We expect this transaction to be highly tax efficient, maximizing the gross proceeds from the sale to be used to accelerate the reduction of debt and strengthen our balance sheet as we enter 2027.” Management will update its 2026 outlook with respect to this sale in connection with its third quarter 2026 report, the timing of which will be announced separately. ADVISORS Moelis & Company LLC is serving as Gibraltar’s exclusive financial advisor and Polsinelli is serving as Gibraltar’s legal counsel. About Gibraltar Gibraltar is a leading manufacturer and provider of products and services for the residential, agtech, and infrastructure markets. Gibraltar’s mission, to make life better for people and the planet, is fueled by advancing the disciplines of engineering, science, and technology. Gibraltar is innovating to reshape critical markets in comfortable living and productive growing throughout North America. For more please visit www.gibraltar1.com .
